description: Update the dashboard to show explanation panels. When a scan result in the live feed or review queue is clicked/expanded, render a formatted explanation. Depends on FEAT-002 (the /explain/:scanId API route). Independent of FEAT-001 at the code level but depends on FEAT-002 for the API endpoint.
steps:
1. Update /Users/shivshankardash/warden/dashboard/shared.ts:
   - Add a new ScanEvent field: 'explanation?: string' to the ScanEvent interface (optional, since older events won't have it).
   - Export a helper function formatExplanation(text: string): string that converts the explanation text to HTML. Split by newlines, wrap each line in a <div>. Bold the first line (the headline). For lines matching the 'Detection path:' pattern, add a CSS class 'detection-path' for highlighting. Escape all text with esc() before wrapping.

2. Update /Users/shivshankardash/warden/dashboard/overview.ts — modify the live feed to support click-to-expand: - In feedRowHtml(e: FeedRow), add a data-scan-id attribute to the .feed-row div: data-scan-id="${esc(e.id)}". - Add a FeedRow field: explanation?: string (optional). - Below the feed section in the HTML rendering, add a detail panel div:
that sits below the clicked row. - Wire click handlers on .feed-row elements: when clicked, fetch GET /explain/{scanId}, render the explanation in the panel using formatExplanation(), and show it below the clicked row. Toggle visibility on re-click. Show a 'Loading explanation…' state while fetching. - Use the json() helper from shared.ts for the fetch.

3. Update /Users/shivshankardash/warden/dashboard/review.ts — show explanation prominently on HUMAN_REVIEW items: - In the card() function, add an explanation section between the meta div and the content pre:
Loading explanation…
. - In renderReviewPanel(), after painting the cards, fetch explanations for each item. Since the review API now returns explanation fields (from FEAT-002), use them directly: if the item has an 'explanation' field, render it. Otherwise fetch from /explain/{scanId}. - Update the ReviewItem interface in review.ts to include explanation?: string. - Format the explanation using formatExplanation() from shared.ts.

4. Add CSS for the explanation panels in /Users/shivshankardash/warden/dashboard/base.css:
   - .explain-panel: background var(--inset), border-radius 8px, padding 16px 20px, margin 8px 0, font-size 13px, line-height 1.6, border 1px solid var(--line). Hidden by default (display: none when [hidden]).
   - .explain-panel.open: display block.
   - .explain-panel .detection-path: font-family monospace, color var(--tier-blocked), font-weight 600.
   - .explain-panel div:first-child: font-weight 600, font-size 14px (the headline).
   - .explain-text (review panel): same styling as .explain-panel but without the toggle behavior — always visible on review items.
   - Ensure dark theme support: the explanation panel should use var() tokens that are overridden in [data-theme='dark'].
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a live feed row fetches and displays an explanation panel below it
The explanation panel shows a formatted, multi-line explanation with the detection path highlighted
Re-clicking the same row hides the panel (toggle behavior)
HUMAN_REVIEW items in the review queue show the explanation prominently without requiring a click
The explanation panel renders correctly in both light and dark themes
All existing tests still pass: DB_PATH=./warden-test.db bun test
verification: Start the server with `bun --hot src/api/index.ts` and verify the dashboard renders without errors, the explanation panel appears on feed row click, and review items show explanations
findings: Implemented all 4 steps: shared.ts exports formatExplanation() helper and ScanEvent now includes optional explanation field. overview.ts feed rows have data-scan-id attributes with click-to-expand explanation panels (toggle on re-click, loading state, fetches from GET /explain/:scanId). review.ts ReviewItem includes optional explanation field and cards render explanation prominently between meta and content sections using formatExplanation(). base.css adds .explain-panel (toggle behavior, hidden by default, monospace detection-path highlighting) and .explain-text (always visible on review items) styles using CSS custom properties for dark theme support. 2 pre-existing test failures in intel.test.ts from dirty src/intel/ files are unrelated; all 303 other tests pass.
